snippet.title: inZOI: Island Getaway Official Trailer (gamescom ONL 2025)
snippet.description:
inZOI: Island Getaway officially revealed at gamescom Opening Night Live 2025.🔥

From adventures you’ve never tried to stories you’ve always dreamed of, Cahaya has it all.
Everyone found their story in Cahaya. What story will you tell?

Step in to experience new lives and adventures—only in inZOI.

🗓️inZOI: Island Getaway Release Date: August 20, 06:00 UTC
🎮 Free DLC available soon on Steam and Mac App Store

“Every life becomes a story.” https://inzoi.me/inZOI_Steam
